text: Stake.com is owned and operated by Medium Rare, N.V., a Curaçao company, and sits under the Australian private group Easygo, controlled by co-founders Ed Craven and Bijan Tehrani. There is no state or sovereign-fund owner - the Everton sleeve is private gambling money. Human-rights relevance is thin: offshore licensing and gambling-consumer issues.
